proposed_widenings.name: unconditional_activation (no-gate instant effect)
proposed_widenings.justification: The activation family requires ActivationPhase entries (attack_roll or save_gate). Create or Destroy Water has no resolution gate — the effect fires unconditionally on cast. A new family or a widened activation that allows zero-phase / unconditional execution is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Duration: Instant; no attack roll and no saving throw appear anywhere in the spell text

proposed_widenings.name: cast_time_choice between mutually exclusive sub-effects
proposed_widenings.justification: The caster chooses one of two named modes (Create Water / Destroy Water) at cast time. No existing surface type models a player-facing binary choice that selects the entire effect graph at activation time. The choose procedure atom exists in v4 but no family wires it into a spell-level branch.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You do one of the following: [Create Water] / [Destroy Water]

proposed_widenings.name: destroy_object
proposed_widenings.justification: The Destroy Water mode removes physical matter from the world (water in a container, or fog). v4 has create_object but no corresponding destroy_object. This is mechanically distinct from remove_condition (conditions are creature states) and damage (which reduces HP).
proposed_widenings.evidence: You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range.

proposed_widenings.name: extinguish_environmental
proposed_widenings.justification: The rain variant of Create Water extinguishes exposed flames in a 30-foot cube. This modifies an environmental hazard state — not a creature condition, not HP damage, not a named effect. No v4 atom covers suppression of environmental fire.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the water falls as rain in a 30-foot Cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames there

notes: All four existing spell families require either a persistent concentration/timed hold (ongoing_effect), a resolution gate — attack_roll or save_gate — (activation), a reaction trigger (triggered_reaction), or a stored deferred trigger (anchored_trigger). Create or Destroy Water is none of these: it is an instantaneous, unconditional world-manipulation spell with a player-facing mode choice at cast time. The structural gap is the absence of an 'instant unconditional effect' family. Secondary gaps are destroy_object and extinguish_environmental atoms. No honest encoding is possible without at least the structural widening.
